# Port of lib/pubid/bsi/parser.rb — BSI designations: BS/BSI published
# standards, adopted EN/ISO/IEC/CEN strings, DD/PD/PAS/TS/PP/NA/Flex
# types, aerospace prefixes, sections, indexes, methods, detailed
# specs, committee documents, standalone AMDs, supplement documents
# (forward/reverse), addenda, sets ("+"), bundles ("and"/"&"/","),
# expert commentary, translations, editions and vap suffixes. The gem's
# parse() input normalization ("BSI " → "BS " prefix strip) is
# Tier-3 preprocessing outside the grammar; stri("...") literals are
# expressed with %i"..." case-insensitive strings. Dead source rule
# `adopted_string_no_expert` is not ported. Internal rule rename:
# `vapSuffix` → `vap_suffix`.
#
# Edition 2 conversion. The builder is wrapper-key-driven: it reads
# index_identifier, supplementary_index_identifier,
# explanatory_supplement_identifier, method_identifier,
# test_method_identifier, section_identifier, detailed_specification,
# aerospace_identifier, disc_identifier, supplement_document,
# addendum_document, set, bundled_parts, bundled_list, parenthesized_amd,
# standalone_amendment, committee_document, index_suffix, method_suffix,
# section_suffix, test_method_suffix, detailed_spec_suffix, na_prefix,
# na_supplements, supplements, iteration, parts and the bundle_item /
# set_item wrappers as HASHES (or arrays of hashes) with nested members
# — data[:number][:number], data[:parts][:parts], data[:iteration]
# [:iteration][0][:iteration] and friends — so every one of those
# wrappers keeps its capture and binds (raw): the raw pass-through
# delivers the inner-capture Hash exactly as the v1 Parslet tree did,
# double captures included. The supplements array binds through the
# element wrapper (supplement -> supplements[].supplement (raw)), the
# NA list keeps its own na_supplements wrapper so its elements never
# leak into the base's supplements (its members carry the original
# capture names; extract_supplements_from_array reads them flat).
# Leaf captures bind (string): every leaf capture body is inlined to
# raw terms because a capture wrapping a structural rule ref
# materializes the ref's element hashes — digits, letter, method_code,
# section_id and the separator bodies are written out at every leaf
# capture site, while pure literal alternations (bs, the prefixes, the
# type words) stay refs and bind as spans. Uncaptured structural tails
# (optional_suffix-style) are kept out of the wrappers so raw values
# stay single hashes; captures reached only through a raw hash stay
# unbound (cen_cenelec-style), which the binding coverage reports as
# warnings only.

grammar PubidBsi version "0.1.0" edition 2 {
  digit = %x30-39
  upper = %x41-5A
  lower = %x61-7A
  letter = upper / lower
  space = " "
  dash = "-"
  slash = "/"
  plus = "+"
  colon = ":"
  non_nl = %x01-09 / %x0B-10FFFF

  bs = "BSI" / "BS"
  multi_letter_prefix = {
      "E9111" / "CECC" / "CISPR"
    / "2HC" / "2HR" / "2SP" / "2TA" / "3HR" / "3TA"
    / "2A" / "2B" / "2C" / "2F" / "2G" / "2L" / "2M" / "2S"
    / "3B" / "3F" / "3G" / "3J" / "3L" / "3S"
    / "4F" / "4L" / "4S" / "5S" / "7S" / "SP"
  }
  single_letter_prefix = {
      "AU" / "HC" / "MA" / "PL" / "QC" / "TA"
    / "A" / "B" / "C" / "F" / "G" / "L" / "M" / "S" / "X"
  }
  specialized_prefix = ( (multi_letter_prefix / single_letter_prefix) ) as prefix
  flex = "BSI Flex" / "BS Flex" / "Flex"
  dd = "DD"
  pd = "PD"
  pas = "PAS"
  na = "NA"
  ts = "TS"
  handbook = "Handbook" / "HB"
  pp = "PP"
  bip = "BIP"
  ep_type = "EP" / "ep"

  index_suffix = {
    ( (space) "Index" (space) "Issue" (space) ((1*digit)) as issue_number )
    / ( ((colon)) as colon_sep "Index" )
    / ( (space) "Index" )
  }
  supplementary_index_suffix = ((space) "Supplementary Index") as supplementary_index_suffix
  explanatory_supplement_suffix = {
    ( (colon) "Explanatory Supplement" ) as explanatory_supplement_suffix
  }
  method_suffix = {
    ( ((colon)) (("Methods")) (space) ((1*(digit / upper))) as method_code (space) "to" (space) ((1*(digit / upper))) as method_to )
    / ( ((colon)) (("Methods")) (space) ((1*(digit / upper))) as method_code (space) "and" (space) ((1*(digit / upper))) as method_and )
    / ( ((colon)) (("Method")) (space) ((1*(digit / upper))) as method_code )
  }
  method_code = 1*(digit / upper)
  test_method_suffix = {
    ((colon)) ((1*(digit / upper))) as test_series ((colon)) ((1*(digit / upper))) as test_id
  }
  set_separator = [space] plus [space]
  set_item = {
    (
      ((bs)) as publisher
      (space)
      [ ((adopted_org_prefix)) as adopted_org (space) ]
      (number)
      [(parts)]
      [((year))]
    ) as set_item
  }
  set_items = { (set_item) 1*( (set_separator) (set_item) ) }
  set_identifier = ( ( ((set_items)) ) as set ) as set
  section_suffix = {
    ( ((colon)) as colon_sep "Section" (space) ((1*(digit / upper / lower))) as section_id )
    / ( (space) "Section" (space) ((1*(digit / upper / lower))) as section_id )
  }
  section_id = 1*(digit / upper / lower)
  detailed_spec_suffix = {
    (space) ( (("C" 1*3digit dash 1*3digit)) as spec_code / (("N" 1*4digit [dash 1*digit])) as spec_code )
  }
  committee_document = {
    (
      ((2digit)) as year
      (slash)
      ((8digit)) as document_number
      (space)
      "DC"
    ) as committee_document
  }
  standalone_amendment = {
    (
      ( ( ((lparen)) "AMD" (space) (("Corrigendum")) as corrigendum (space) ((1*digit)) as amendment_number ((rparen)) ) ) as parenthesized_amd
      / ( ( ((lparen)) "AMD" (space) ((1*digit)) as amendment_number ((rparen)) ) ) as parenthesized_amd
      / ( ( (("AMD")) (space) (("Corrigendum")) as corrigendum (space) ((1*digit)) as amendment_number ) ) as standalone_amendment
      / ( ( (("AMD")) (space) ((1*digit)) as amendment_number ) ) as standalone_amendment
    )
  }
  lparen = "("
  rparen = ")"
  disc_prefix = "DISC PD "
  draft = "Draft BS" / "DBS"
  en = "EN"
  iso = "ISO"
  iec = "IEC"
  cispr = "CISPR"
  cen = "CEN"
  clc = "CLC"
  # The NA supplement list inlines the four supplement forms with the
  # original member capture names (no supplement element wrapper): the
  # builder's extract_supplements_from_array reads unwrapped member
  # hashes, and keeping the `supplement` capture out of this branch
  # stops the NA amendments from leaking into the base's supplements.
  na_with_supplements = {
    (
      1*(
          (
            ((plus) as amd_sep_plus / (slash) as amd_sep_slash)
            "A"
            ((1*digit)) as amd_number
            [(colon) ((2*4digit)) as amd_year]
          )
        / (
            ((plus) as amd_sep_plus / (slash) as amd_sep_slash)
            "Amd"
            (space)
            ((1*digit)) as amd_number
            [(colon) ((4digit)) as amd_year]
        )
        / (
            ((plus) as amd_sep_plus / (slash) as amd_sep_slash)
            "AC"
            [ ((1*digit)) as cor_number ]
            [(colon) ((2*4digit)) as cor_year]
        )
        / (
            ((plus) as amd_sep_plus / (slash) as amd_sep_slash)
            "C"
            ((1*digit)) as cor_number
            [(colon) ((2*4digit)) as cor_year]
        )
        / (
            (space)
            "AMD"
            [space]
            (((1*digit)) as amd_number / ((1*upper)) as amd_letter)
        )
        / (
            (space)
            (("Amd" / "Amendment")) as amd_verbose_type
            (space)
            ((1*digit)) as amd_number
            [(space) "(" ((1*(digit / "/"))) as amd_date ")"]
            [(colon) ((1*(%x41-5A / %x61-7A))) as amd_month (space) ((4digit)) as amd_year]
        )
      )
    ) as na_supplements
  }
  na_simple = "NA to "
  na_prefix = {
    ( ( (("NA")) [na_with_supplements] (space) "to " ) / ( (na_simple) ) ) as na_prefix
  }
  publisher_or_type = {
      ( (na_prefix) (draft as stage / dd as type / pd as type / bs as publisher) )
    / ( ((flex)) as flex_type )
    / ( ((handbook)) as type )
    / ( ((bip)) as type )
    / ( ((ts)) as type )
    / ( ((ep_type)) as type )
    / ( ((draft)) as stage )
    / ( ((dd)) as type )
    / ( ((pd)) as type )
    / ( ((pas)) as type )
    / ( ((pp)) as type )
    / ( ((na)) as type )
    / ( (((bs)) as publisher) (space) (specialized_prefix) )
    / ( ((bs)) as publisher )
  }

  number = (1*(digit / upper)) as number
  part_with_subpart = (dash) ((1*digit)) as part (dash) ((1*digit)) as subpart
  part = (dash) ((1*(digit / (%x41-5A / %x61-7A) / "." / "&" / space))) as part
  parts = ( *( (part_with_subpart) / (part) ) ) as parts
  part_with_letter_edition = {
    ( ((dash)) ((1*(digit / "."))) as part ((letter_edition)) as letter_edition )
    / ( ((dash)) ((1*(digit / "."))) as part )
  }
  number_with_letter_edition = {
    ( ((1*digit)) as number ((letter_edition)) as letter_edition )
    / ( ((1*digit)) as number )
  }
  space_separated_part = (space) ((1*upper 1*digit)) as part
  # iteration: the rule-level capture nests under the use-site capture,
  # restoring the v1 data[:iteration][:iteration][0][:iteration] walk.
  iteration = ( *( "[" ((1*digit)) as iteration "]" ) ) as iteration
  year = (colon) ((3*4digit)) as year
  base_year = (colon) ((4digit)) as base_year
  month = (dash) ((2digit)) as month
  flex_edition = (space) "v" ((1*(digit / "."))) as edition
  edition = (space) "ED" ((1*digit)) as edition
  letter_edition = ((%x41-5A / %x61-7A)) as letter_edition
  amendment = {
    (
      (
        ((plus) as amd_sep_plus / (slash) as amd_sep_slash)
        "A"
        ((1*digit)) as amd_number
        [(colon) ((2*4digit)) as amd_year]
      )
      / (
          ((plus) as amd_sep_plus / (slash) as amd_sep_slash)
          "Amd"
          (space)
          ((1*digit)) as amd_number
          [(colon) ((4digit)) as amd_year]
      )
    )
  }
  corrigendum = {
    (
      (
        ((plus) as amd_sep_plus / (slash) as amd_sep_slash)
        "AC"
        [ ((1*digit)) as cor_number ]
        [(colon) ((2*4digit)) as cor_year]
      )
      / (
          ((plus) as amd_sep_plus / (slash) as amd_sep_slash)
          "C"
          ((1*digit)) as cor_number
          [(colon) ((2*4digit)) as cor_year]
      )
    )
  }
  amd_suffix = (space) "AMD" [space] (((1*digit)) as amd_number / ((1*upper)) as amd_letter)
  amd_verbose = {
    (space) (("Amd" / "Amendment")) as amd_verbose_type (space) ((1*digit)) as amd_number
    [ (space) "(" ((1*(digit / "/"))) as amd_date ")" ]
    [ (colon) ((1*(%x41-5A / %x61-7A))) as amd_month (space) ((4digit)) as amd_year ]
  }

  supplement_document_forward = {
    (
      (
        (
          ((bs)) as publisher
          (space)
          ((multi_letter_prefix)) as flex_prefix
          (space)
          (((1*(digit / upper)))) as number
          ((iteration)) as iteration
          ((parts)) as parts
          ((colon / space)) as supp_sep
          "Supplement"
          (space)
          (("No.")) as supp_no_prefix
          (space)
          ((1*digit)) as supplement_number
          (colon)
          ((4digit)) as supplement_year
        )
      ) as supplement_document
      / (
          (
            ((bs)) as publisher
            (space)
            ((multi_letter_prefix)) as flex_prefix
            (space)
            (((1*(digit / upper)))) as number
            ((iteration)) as iteration
            ((parts)) as parts
            ((colon / space)) as supp_sep
            "Supplement"
            (space)
            ((1*digit)) as supplement_number
            (colon)
            ((4digit)) as supplement_year
          )
      ) as supplement_document
      / (
          (
            ((bs)) as publisher
            (space)
            ((single_letter_prefix)) as flex_prefix
            (space)
            (((1*(digit / upper)))) as number
            ((iteration)) as iteration
            ((parts)) as parts
            ((colon / space)) as supp_sep
            "Supplement"
            (space)
            (("No.")) as supp_no_prefix
            (space)
            ((1*digit)) as supplement_number
            (colon)
            ((4digit)) as supplement_year
          )
      ) as supplement_document
      / (
          (
            ((bs)) as publisher
            (space)
            ((single_letter_prefix)) as flex_prefix
            (space)
            (((1*(digit / upper)))) as number
            ((iteration)) as iteration
            ((parts)) as parts
            ((colon / space)) as supp_sep
            "Supplement"
            (space)
            ((1*digit)) as supplement_number
            (colon)
            ((4digit)) as supplement_year
          )
      ) as supplement_document
      / (
          (
            ((bs)) as publisher
            (space)
            (((1*(digit / upper)))) as number
            ((iteration)) as iteration
            ((parts)) as parts
            ((colon / space)) as supp_sep
            "Supplement"
            (space)
            (("No.")) as supp_no_prefix
            (space)
            ((1*digit)) as supplement_number
            (colon)
            ((4digit)) as supplement_year
          )
      ) as supplement_document
      / (
          (
            ((bs)) as publisher
            (space)
            (((1*(digit / upper)))) as number
            ((iteration)) as iteration
            ((parts)) as parts
            ((colon / space)) as supp_sep
            "Supplement"
            (space)
            ((1*digit)) as supplement_number
            (colon)
            ((4digit)) as supplement_year
          )
      ) as supplement_document
    )
  }
  supplement_document_reverse = {
    (
      (
        (
          (("Supplement"))
          (space)
          (("No.")) as supp_no_prefix
          (space)
          ((1*digit)) as supplement_number
          (space)
          ((lparen))
          ((4digit)) as supplement_year
          ((rparen))
          (space)
          "to "
          ((bs)) as publisher
          (space)
          (((1*(digit / upper)))) as number
          ((iteration)) as iteration
          ((parts)) as parts
          (colon)
          ((4digit)) as base_year
        )
      ) as supplement_document
      / (
          (
            (("Supplement"))
            (space)
            ((1*digit)) as supplement_number
            (space)
            ((lparen))
            ((4digit)) as supplement_year
            ((rparen))
            (space)
            "to "
            ((bs)) as publisher
            (space)
            (((1*(digit / upper)))) as number
            ((iteration)) as iteration
            ((parts)) as parts
            (colon)
            ((4digit)) as base_year
          )
      ) as supplement_document
    )
  }
  addendum_document = {
    (
      (
        (
          ((bs)) as publisher
          (space)
          ((multi_letter_prefix)) as flex_prefix
          (space)
          (((1*(digit / upper)))) as number
          ((iteration)) as iteration
          ((parts)) as parts
          ((colon / space)) as add_sep
          "Addendum"
          1*space
          (("No.")) as add_no_prefix
          1*space
          ((1*digit)) as addendum_number
          (colon)
          ((4digit)) as addendum_year
        )
      ) as addendum_document
      / (
          (
            ((bs)) as publisher
            (space)
            ((multi_letter_prefix)) as flex_prefix
            (space)
            (((1*(digit / upper)))) as number
            ((iteration)) as iteration
            ((parts)) as parts
            ((colon / space)) as add_sep
            "Addendum"
            1*space
            ((1*digit)) as addendum_number
            (colon)
            ((4digit)) as addendum_year
          )
      ) as addendum_document
      / (
          (
            ((bs)) as publisher
            (space)
            ((single_letter_prefix)) as flex_prefix
            (space)
            (((1*(digit / upper)))) as number
            ((iteration)) as iteration
            ((parts)) as parts
            ((colon / space)) as add_sep
            "Addendum"
            1*space
            (("No.")) as add_no_prefix
            1*space
            ((1*digit)) as addendum_number
            (colon)
            ((4digit)) as addendum_year
          )
      ) as addendum_document
      / (
          (
            ((bs)) as publisher
            (space)
            ((single_letter_prefix)) as flex_prefix
            (space)
            (((1*(digit / upper)))) as number
            ((iteration)) as iteration
            ((parts)) as parts
            ((colon / space)) as add_sep
            "Addendum"
            1*space
            ((1*digit)) as addendum_number
            (colon)
            ((4digit)) as addendum_year
          )
      ) as addendum_document
      / (
          (
            ((bs)) as publisher
            (space)
            (((1*(digit / upper)))) as number
            ((iteration)) as iteration
            ((parts)) as parts
            ((colon / space)) as add_sep
            "Addendum"
            1*space
            (("No.")) as add_no_prefix
            1*space
            ((1*digit)) as addendum_number
            (colon)
            ((4digit)) as addendum_year
          )
      ) as addendum_document
      / (
          (
            ((bs)) as publisher
            (space)
            (((1*(digit / upper)))) as number
            ((iteration)) as iteration
            ((parts)) as parts
            ((colon / space)) as add_sep
            "Addendum"
            1*space
            ((1*digit)) as addendum_number
            (colon)
            ((4digit)) as addendum_year
          )
      ) as addendum_document
      / (
          (
            ((bs)) as publisher
            (space)
            (((1*(digit / upper)))) as number
            ((iteration)) as iteration
            ((parts)) as parts
            (colon)
            ((4digit)) as base_year
            ((space)) as add_sep
            "Addendum"
            1*space
            (("No.")) as add_no_prefix
            1*space
            ((1*digit)) as addendum_number
            (colon)
            ((4digit)) as addendum_year
          )
      ) as addendum_document
      / (
          (
            ((bs)) as publisher
            (space)
            (((1*(digit / upper)))) as number
            ((iteration)) as iteration
            ((parts)) as parts
            (colon)
            ((4digit)) as base_year
            ((colon)) as add_sep
            "Addendum"
            1*space
            (("No.")) as add_no_prefix
            1*space
            ((1*digit)) as addendum_number
            (colon)
            ((4digit)) as addendum_year
          )
      ) as addendum_document
      / (
          (
            ((bs)) as publisher
            (space)
            (((1*(digit / upper)))) as number
            ((iteration)) as iteration
            ((parts)) as parts
            ((colon / space)) as add_sep
            "Addendum"
            1*space
            (("No.")) as add_no_prefix
            1*space
            ((1*digit)) as addendum_number
            (colon)
            ((4digit)) as addendum_year
          )
      ) as addendum_document
      / (
          (
            ((bs)) as publisher
            (space)
            (((1*(digit / upper)))) as number
            ((iteration)) as iteration
            ((parts)) as parts
            ((colon / space)) as add_sep
            "Addendum"
            1*space
            ((1*digit)) as addendum_number
            (colon)
            ((4digit)) as addendum_year
          )
      ) as addendum_document
    )
  }
  bundle_sep_and = (space) "and" (space)
  bundle_sep_to = (space) (("TO" / "to") as to_case) (space)
  bundle_sep_ampersand = (space) "&" (space)
  bundle_sep_semicolon = ";" (space)
  bundle_sep_comma = ","
  bundle_separator = {
    ( ((space) "and" (space)) ) as sep_and
    / ( ((space) (("TO" / "to") as to_case) (space)) ) as sep_to
    / ( ((space) "&" (space)) ) as sep_ampersand
    / ( (";" (space)) ) as sep_semicolon
    / ( (",") ) as sep_comma
  }
  parts_bundle = {
    (("Parts" / "Sections")) as bundle_type (space) ((1*digit)) as part1 (bundle_sep_and) ((1*(digit / "."))) as part2
  }
  bundle_item = {
    ( ( ((bs)) as publisher (space) ((multi_letter_prefix)) as prefix (space) (number) (parts) ) ) as bundle_item
    / ( ( ((bs)) as publisher (space) ((single_letter_prefix)) as prefix (space) (number) (parts) ) ) as bundle_item
    / ( ( ((bs)) as publisher (space) (number) (space_separated_part) ) ) as bundle_item
    / ( ( ((bs)) as publisher (space) (number) (parts) ) ) as bundle_item
    / ( ( ((multi_letter_prefix)) as prefix (space) (number) (parts) ) ) as bundle_item
    / ( ( ((single_letter_prefix)) as prefix (space) (number) (parts) ) ) as bundle_item
    / ( ( (number) (space_separated_part) ) ) as bundle_item
    / ( ((1*upper 1*digit)) as bundle_item )
    / ( ( (number) (parts) ) ) as bundle_item
  }
  bundled_identifier = {
    ( ( (publisher_or_type) (space) (number) (colon) (parts_bundle) ((year)) ) ) as bundled_parts
    / ( ( (publisher_or_type) (space) (bundle_item) 1*( (bundle_separator) (bundle_item) ) [((year))] ) ) as bundled_list
  }

  supplement = { ( ( (amendment) / (corrigendum) / (amd_suffix) / (amd_verbose) ) ) as supplement }
  supplements = ( *(supplement) ) as supplements
  expert_commentary = {
    (space)
    (
      ((%i"Expert Commentary")) as expert_commentary_full
      / ( ( ( (%i"ExComm") [ (space) ((lparen)) ((1*(%x41-5A / %x61-7A))) as expert_commentary_topic ((rparen)) ] ) ) as expert_commentary )
    )
  }
  tracked_changes = (space) (dash) (space) "TC" as tracked_changes
  pdf_suffix = (space) "PDF" as pdf
  translation = {
    ( (space) ((lparen)) (((1*(%x41-5A / %x61-7A)))) as translation_lang [(space) ("Translation" / "version")] ((rparen)) )
    / ( (space) ((("SPANISH" / "FRENCH" / "GERMAN" / "ITALIAN"))) as translation_upper (space) "TRANSLATION" )
  }
  collection_number = (slash) ((1*digit)) as second_number
  adopted_org_prefix = {
      "CISPR" / "ENV" / "IEC" / "ISO" / "CEN" / "CLC"
    / "CWA" / "CR" / "ES" / "HD" / "EN"
  }
  # adopted_string_content is inlined at both capture sites: a capture
  # wrapping the rule's ref would materialize the ref's structure.
  adopted_string_content = {
      !(supplement)
      !(amd_suffix)
      !(amd_verbose)
      !(expert_commentary)
      !(tracked_changes)
      !(pdf_suffix)
      !(translation)
      1*non_nl
  }
  adopted_string = {
    (
      (adopted_org_prefix)
      (!(supplement) !(amd_suffix) !(amd_verbose) !(expert_commentary) !(tracked_changes) !(pdf_suffix) !(translation) 1*non_nl)
    ) as adopted_string
  }
  bare_adopted = {
    (
      (!(bs))
      (adopted_org_prefix)
      *( (!(supplement) !(amd_suffix) !(amd_verbose) !(tracked_changes) !(pdf_suffix) !(translation) non_nl) )
    ) as adopted_string
  }
  vap_suffix = {
      ((space) "PDF" as pdf_format)
    / ((space) "BOOK" as book_format)
    / ( ((space) (dash) (space) "TC") as tc_format )
  }

  identifier = {
      standalone_amendment
    / committee_document
    / ( ( ((bs)) as publisher (space) (number) ((index_suffix)) as index_suffix ((year)) ) ) as index_identifier
    / ( ( ((bs)) as publisher (space) (number) ((supplementary_index_suffix)) as supplementary_index_suffix ((year)) ) ) as supplementary_index_identifier
    / ( ( ((bs)) as publisher (space) (number) (parts) ((explanatory_supplement_suffix)) as explanatory_supplement_suffix ((year)) ) ) as explanatory_supplement_identifier
    / ( ( ((bs)) as publisher (space) (number) (parts) ((method_suffix)) as method_suffix ((year)) ) ) as method_identifier
    / ( ( ((bs)) as publisher (space) (number) ((test_method_suffix)) as test_method_suffix ((year)) ) ) as test_method_identifier
    / ( ( (publisher_or_type) (space) (number) ((section_suffix)) as section_suffix ((year)) ) ) as section_identifier
    / ( ( ((bs)) as publisher (space) (number) ((detailed_spec_suffix)) as detailed_spec_suffix ((year)) ) ) as detailed_specification
    / (
        ( ( ((bs)) as publisher (space) ((single_letter_prefix / multi_letter_prefix)) as prefix (space)
            (number_with_letter_edition) [(part_with_letter_edition)] [ ( ( "[" ((1*digit)) as iteration "]" ) as iteration ) ] ((year)) [supplements] ) ) as aerospace_identifier
      )
    / ( ( (disc_prefix) (number) [(parts)] ((year)) ) ) as disc_identifier
    / supplement_document_reverse
    / supplement_document_forward
    / addendum_document
    / set_identifier
    / bundled_identifier
    / bare_adopted
    / ( ((flex)) as flex_type (space) (number) (parts) [(flex_edition)] [((year)) [(month)]] [supplements] )
    / (
        (publisher_or_type)
        [ (space) (adopted_string) ]
        [ (space) (number) (parts) [(collection_number)] [((year)) [(month)]] [(flex_edition)] ]
        [supplements]
        [(edition)]
        [(expert_commentary)]
        [(translation)]
        [(vap_suffix)]
      )
  }

  entry identifier: identifier

  bindings identifier {
    # leaves the builder reads flat (or that ride along for lint parity)
    publisher -> publisher (string)
    type -> type (string)
    stage -> stage (string)
    prefix -> prefix (string)
    flex_prefix -> flex_prefix (string)
    flex_type -> flex_type (string)
    number -> number (string)
    second_number -> second_number (string)
    part -> part (string)
    year -> year (string)
    base_year -> base_year (string)
    month -> month (string)
    edition -> edition (string)
    issue_number -> issue_number (string)
    colon_sep -> colon_sep (string)
    supplementary_index_suffix -> supplementary_index_suffix (raw)
    explanatory_supplement_suffix -> explanatory_supplement_suffix (raw)
    section_id -> section_id (string)
    spec_code -> spec_code (string)
    method_code -> method_code (string)
    method_to -> method_to (string)
    method_and -> method_and (string)
    test_series -> test_series (string)
    test_id -> test_id (string)
    document_number -> document_number (string)
    corrigendum -> corrigendum (string)
    amendment_number -> amendment_number (string)
    amd_sep_plus -> amd_sep_plus (string)
    amd_sep_slash -> amd_sep_slash (string)
    amd_number -> amd_number (string)
    amd_year -> amd_year (string)
    amd_letter -> amd_letter (string)
    amd_verbose_type -> amd_verbose_type (string)
    amd_date -> amd_date (string)
    amd_month -> amd_month (string)
    cor_number -> cor_number (string)
    cor_year -> cor_year (string)
    supp_sep -> supp_sep (string)
    supp_no_prefix -> supp_no_prefix (string)
    supplement_number -> supplement_number (string)
    supplement_year -> supplement_year (string)
    add_no_prefix -> add_no_prefix (string)
    addendum_number -> addendum_number (string)
    addendum_year -> addendum_year (string)
    add_sep -> add_sep (string)
    expert_commentary_full -> expert_commentary_full (string)
    tracked_changes -> tracked_changes (string)
    pdf -> pdf (string)
    pdf_format -> pdf_format (string)
    book_format -> book_format (string)
    tc_format -> tc_format (string)
    translation_lang -> translation_lang (string)
    translation_upper -> translation_upper (string)
    adopted_string -> adopted_string (string)
    sep_and -> sep_and (string)
    sep_ampersand -> sep_ampersand (string)
    sep_semicolon -> sep_semicolon (string)
    sep_comma -> sep_comma (string)
    bundle_type -> bundle_type (string)
    part1 -> part1 (string)
    part2 -> part2 (string)
    # one-level arrays the builder walks by index
    part -> parts[].part (string)
    subpart -> parts[].subpart (string)
    supplement -> supplements[].supplement (raw)
    # the wrapper hashes (and hash-arrays) the builder dispatches on
    # and unwraps member by member
    iteration -> iteration (raw)
    letter_edition -> letter_edition (raw)
    sep_to -> sep_to (raw)
    index_suffix -> index_suffix (raw)
    method_suffix -> method_suffix (raw)
    section_suffix -> section_suffix (raw)
    test_method_suffix -> test_method_suffix (raw)
    detailed_spec_suffix -> detailed_spec_suffix (raw)
    committee_document -> committee_document (raw)
    parenthesized_amd -> parenthesized_amd (raw)
    standalone_amendment -> standalone_amendment (raw)
    na_prefix -> na_prefix (raw)
    na_supplements -> na_supplements (raw)
    index_identifier -> index_identifier (raw)
    supplementary_index_identifier -> supplementary_index_identifier (raw)
    explanatory_supplement_identifier -> explanatory_supplement_identifier (raw)
    method_identifier -> method_identifier (raw)
    test_method_identifier -> test_method_identifier (raw)
    section_identifier -> section_identifier (raw)
    detailed_specification -> detailed_specification (raw)
    aerospace_identifier -> aerospace_identifier (raw)
    disc_identifier -> disc_identifier (raw)
    supplement_document -> supplement_document (raw)
    addendum_document -> addendum_document (raw)
    set -> set (raw)
    bundled_parts -> bundled_parts (raw)
    bundled_list -> bundled_list (raw)
    expert_commentary -> expert_commentary (raw)
  }

  test {
    accept "BS 5950-1:2000"
    accept "PD 5500:2018"
    accept "DD 240-1:2010"
    accept "BS 5950-1:2000+A1:2010"
    accept "AMD 1"
    reject "nonsense"
  }
}
